events.tiebreak: Overtime! Two glizzies on the table. First to bite one loses.

broadcast.title: Cup preview
weatherReports: Blizzard all evening. The glizzies steam twice as hard.
Ice on the table, ice in the stomachs. First to shiver, first to go home.
Snow up to the knees, and the knees are shaking. A glizzy only warms you from the inside.
Red sky, and the wind is blowing leaves across the table.
Fog has settled on the valley. You can see exactly as far as you need to: the glizzy.
Leaves rustling, rain threatening. Nobody brought an umbrella. Everybody brought glizzies.
A tropical night. The table is hot, the appetites hotter.
Muggy since morning. The mustard melts before it reaches the bun.
Not a breath of wind. The mosquitoes counted the contestants before the judges did.
Everything is in bloom and smells lovely. The glizzy smells strongest.
Pollen in the air, tears in the eyes. Some from allergies, some from the draw.
First real sun of the year. The eggplants are glowing, and so are the contestants.

page.intro: You're the coach. Pick a character from the classifieds, run them season after season, and train them all the way to Glizzy Overlord.

start.confirmNew: Your current career will be wiped. Start over?
start.deleteConfirm: The career in this slot is gone for good. Sure?

headlines.title: WHITE DWARF BACK IN THE LEAGUE
headlines.text: Black Dwarf Corporation is back as league sponsor after a 10-year ban for blackmail. By the book this time, they insist.

headlines.title: GLIZZY CRISIS HITS THE VALLEY
headlines.text: Glizzy prices jump for the third time this winter.

headlines.title: THE RABBIT BACK AT THE BLUE CABIN?
headlines.text: Fresh tracks in the snow and a pantry without a single glizzy left. Mr Bones refuses to testify.

ad.title: COACH WANTED
ad.text: The league is starting up again, and one competitor is coming back after a long break and needs a coach.

streak-broken.headline: {name} ENDS THE LOSING RUN
lines: Finally, a reason to get up.
Alarm went off. So did I.
Morning. Mind the body on the floor.

opponent-burst.headline: {other} BURSTS, {name} CHEERS
lines: Heh heh heh... HA HA HA HA!
Hee hee hee... HO HO HO HO!
Mwahaha... MWAHAHAHAHA!

opponent-removed.headline: {name}'S OPPONENT TAKEN AWAY
lines: Officer, this man dented my car.
I braked. Eventually.
Wrong place, wrong time, right bumper.

favorite-wins.headline: {name} WINS IN STYLE
lines: Not a hair out of place.
Winning is a dress code.
Cameras this way. Loser that way.

underdog-wins.headline: {name} TOPPLES THE FAVORITE
lines: Bonk. That's the whole strategy.
Favorites bruise like everyone else.
One spoon beats all the odds.

photo-finish.headline: {name} WINS BY A CRUMB
lines: Won by a crumb. Still counts.
Can't lift my head. Finger works.
Photo finish. Frame it.

loss-collapse.headline: {name} COLLAPSES MID-MATCH
lines: I'm fine. This floor is fine.
Don't move me. I live here now.
Tell them I'm resting. Indefinitely.

first-match-exit.headline: {name} OUT AT FIRST HURDLE
lines: I keep seeing that first bite.
Out in round one. On repeat.
One match. A lifetime of replays.

upset-loss.headline: {name} LOSES TO AN UNDERDOG
lines: Fair result... TURN THAT OFF!
No hard feelings... WHO PUT THIS ON?!
Well played... GIVE ME THE REMOTE!

heavy-loss-escape.headline: {name} FLEES AFTER DEFEAT
lines: If anyone asks, I was never here.
Doors are for winners.
Window's faster. Trust me.

heavy-loss-pillory.headline: {name} IN THE PILLORY
lines: Easy with the tomatoes, people!
Fine, I deserved it. Not the eye!
Okay! Message received!

losing-streak.headline: {name} STACKS UP LOSSES
lines: Another one for the wall.
Running out of wall. And chalk.
The chalk broke before I did.

tax-office.headline: {name} SETTLES THE TAX BILL
lines: Money comes, money goes. Mostly goes.
Take it all. Leave the watch.
Pockets? Also empty. Go ahead, check.

champion-trophy.headline: {name} WINS THE CUP
lines: There you are, gorgeous.
Mine. All mine.
Been looking for you all season.

champion-chicken.headline: {name} WINS, SERVES CHICKEN
lines: Cup for me, chicken for you.
Second place eats first. Enjoy.
Roast chicken. The loser's portion.

champion-egg.headline: {name} WINS CUP, NO SWEAT
lines: Easy.
Over easy.
Nothing to it.

champion-brain.headline: {name} OUTTHINKS THE FIELD
lines: All brains, no sweat.
Pure science.
Think first, eat second.

champion-crowd.headline: {name} WINS, CROWD GOES WILD
lines: Careful, the cup is fragile!
Carry me home, you know the way!
Drop me if you must. Not the cup!

runner-up.headline: {name} SETTLES FOR SILVER
lines: Silver is gold with a frown.
Second place. First of the losers.
Congrats. I'll be staring at a wall.

wooden-spoon.headline: {name} WINS THE WOODEN SPOON
lines: Wooden, but mine.
Dead last. Still got hardware.
Great, I needed a spoon anyway.

sponsor-signed.headline: {name} SIGNS A SPONSOR
lines: Works for me.
Deal.
Where do I sign?

price-crash.headline: {name}'S TRUCK SINKS PRICES
lines: Spill it and it's half price.
A tragedy. What a bargain.
Floor prices, straight off the floor.

actions.islandDesc: A little boat to The Island, where nobody counts the money. Cholesterol to zero, appetite and ambition maxed. Costs no month, once a year.
actions.islandDescEveryWindow: A little boat to The Island, where nobody counts the money. Cholesterol to zero, appetite and ambition maxed. Costs no month, once per off-season.
actions.restDesc: Cholesterol -{stressMin} to -{stressMax}, appetite {appetiteMin} to +{appetiteMax} and ambition up to ±{drift}, it depends. Ego moves up to {drift} toward {ego}, fame -{fame}.

toast.mediaScandalBackfire: The scandal got out of hand. It's all ash and smoke now.
toast.guard: Security crew hired, stops {pct}% of attacks
toast.island: Island Weekend, body good as new
toast.egoHijack: Ego over {threshold}: signed up for {training} without asking
toast.slumpGuard: Ambition under {threshold}: paid a security crew to be left alone, stops {pct}% of attacks

info.what: The price index of a glizzy in town, measured against the day the career began. When the glizzy gets pricier, so does everything the city charges for.
info.moves: Every off-season there is a {chance}% chance of news: the glizzy goes up or down by {min} to {max}%. Changes multiply, and the index never drops below {floor}% or climbs above {ceiling}% of the starting price.
info.prices: Multiplies the prices of: {categories}. Seasonal prices stack on top.
info.notPrices: Doesn't touch: media pay, donations and prize money.
info.rating: A price hike costs the ruling party {hikeMin} to {hikeMax} rating, a price drop earns it {dropMin} to {dropMax}. With no government, there is no one to blame.
info.nowFlat: Today: everything at the starting price

seasonPrices.intro: Every edition changes the price of something.
seasonPrices.none: First season: everything at list price

info.stress: Rises with matches, training and risky moves. Over 80 is the red zone, where every move risks a collapse. At 100 a collapse and a forfeit are guaranteed. Rest brings it down.
info.appetite: How much gets eaten in a match: best around the middle. Under 20 is stuffed and may forfeit, over 80 is starving. Matches, rest and fasting move it.
info.ambition: The will to compete. Under 15 there's a risk of forfeiting without a fight, and at the start of the off-season your character pays for the cheapest security crew alone or, if broke, fasts.
info.ego: Over 75 the ego takes over and spends the first off-season slot on its own. Under 15 it's stage fright: extra cholesterol and a forfeit risk. Rest pulls it toward {target}, a security crew and sabotage push it up.
info.fame: Required for sponsor offers (50+) and part of your points in the standings. Media, wins and a high cup finish raise it, a poor finish drops it. Every rest costs {drop}, because the papers forget you fast.
info.skillsIntro: A skill levels up after 3 trainings, up to level 3. Repeating the same training without rest risks losing a level.

sniffer.name: Super Sniffer
sniffer.desc: Sometimes smells the glizzy and dodges it better.

fans.name: Media Training
fans.desc: More money and fame from media, less cholesterol. From level 2, two appearances per off-season.

descs.security: Guards at the door around the clock. They work even in a season when you skip the security crew.
descs.spa: Straight to the spa after every cup: steam, mud and a long soak.
descs.assistant: Runs training sessions while you're away. Costs no month and no risk of overtraining.
descs.scout: Hangs around the taverns, listens in and reports it all back to you. You get a look at other people's business.

effects.spa: -{drop} cholesterol at the start of every off-season
effects.scout2: also see the chart: cholesterol, appetite, ego
effects.scout3: also see temper, contracts and cash

cup.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing forfeits the next match and ends your cup. Sure?
cup.betAgainstWarning: You're betting AGAINST your own character. If word gets out, cholesterol goes through the roof and ego drops to the basement.
cup.scandalToast: It leaked. Your character knows you bet against them.
cup.withdrawToast: You pulled your character out of the cup.

welcome.subject: Previous coach: Just so you know

body.one: Here's the key to the gym and the {amount} glizar left in the till. Each off-season has three months, one thing per month: training, rest, media, or something smarter. Watch the cholesterol, read the paper, then head to the cup. A sponsor calls once you're worth something. I'm off to make tea.
body.few: Here's the key to the gym and the {amount} glizars left in the till. Each off-season has three months, one thing per month: training, rest, media, or something smarter. Watch the cholesterol, read the paper, then head to the cup. A sponsor calls once you're worth something. I'm off to make tea.
body.other: Here's the key to the gym and the {amount} glizars left in the till. Each off-season has three months, one thing per month: training, rest, media, or something smarter. Watch the cholesterol, read the paper, then head to the cup. A sponsor calls once you're worth something. I'm off to make tea.

stipendCut.subject: League: Stipend Cancelled
stipendCut.body: We were pleased to hear that you finally found a sponsor. We are even more pleased to tell you that, as of today, we no longer pay your stipend. Congratulations!

body.one: The Federation has assigned you a rival for this year: {name}. Your cup match is a derby. Win it: +{fame} fame, +{ego} ego and {money} glizar from the fund. Lose it: +{stress} cholesterol and -{egoLoss} ego. Rivals aim sabotage at you, so a security crew is not a bad idea. The rival changes every year.

Lose it: +{stress} cholesterol and -{egoLoss} ego. Rivals aim sabotage at you, so a security crew is not a bad idea. The rival changes every year.

investmentsUnlocked.subject: League: Investment Fund Approved
investmentsUnlocked.body: Now that a sponsor stands behind you, the Federation also allows you permanent contracts: a security crew, a spa and an assistant coach.

underworldUnlocked.subject: League: Off-Season Warning
underworldUnlocked.body: The Federation has received reports that certain competitors get up to illegal activities in the off-season. The Federation condemns any form of sabotage or unsportsmanlike conduct in the strongest terms. Anyone caught will pay a fine.

tapeUnlocked.subject: League: New Broadcast Graphics
tapeUnlocked.body: Starting next cup, the broadcast gets an intro board before every match: odds, form and head-to-head record, all in one place.

studioUnlocked.subject: League: The Studio Is Finished
studioUnlocked.body: Starting next cup, we open the tournament live: title odds, the weather forecast and a little gossip, all before the first match.

seasonPrices.subject: League: Prices for {season}
bodies: It's winter and the guards want winter gear. Security costs {pct}% more than usual this season.
The gyms are empty and the trainers are hungry for work. All training is {pct}% cheaper this season.
It's summer, there's no news, and every interview is front-page material. Media pays {pct}% more this season.
Due to a backlog at the Federation's investigations department, only urgent cases will be looked into this season. (Sabotage costs {pct}% less this season.)
reversedBodies: It's winter and the guards are sitting around in taverns with nothing to do. Security costs {pct}% less than usual this season.
The gyms are packed and the trainers get to pick their clients. All training is {pct}% pricier this season.
It's summer, everyone is at the seaside and nobody reads the paper. Media pays {pct}% less this season.
The Federation's investigations department has new hires and is checking every report this season. (Sabotage costs {pct}% more this season.)

bettingUnlocked.subject: League: Betting Allowed Again
bettingUnlocked.body: Please be informed that the ban on match betting is officially lifted. The commission has finished its work and the culprits have been swept out, so the bookie reopens with the next cup.

donation.subject: {sponsor}: Campaign Call

bodies.zidari: Dear friend, the Masons are running for the Leskovac Assembly and we are counting on you. Our platform is simple: a wall around every street that votes for us, and peace and quiet behind it. Every glizar you put into the campaign is one more brick, and the boss personally remembers everyone who built with us. Join in, so that after the election we all sit on the right side of the wall.
bodies.ostrvo: Esteemed guest, this time The Island is running in the election. We promise nothing, only discretion for those who back us and for the accounts they keep with us. Your campaign contribution passes through no ledger at all, and your name goes on the list of friends of the house.
bodies.korporacija: This is a call for voluntary support of the Black Dwarf Corporation electoral list. Our platform: order in housing, order in debts, order in the Assembly. You choose the amount, we keep the records. A reminder that your relatives live in our apartments, and we will gladly inform them that you supported the stability of the city. Thanking you in advance.
bodies.stranka: Friend in freedom, Pčinja is voting and your face is already on the poster. The People's List is running for a free Leskovac. There is no freedom without a campaign, and no campaign without glizars. Whatever you give, state media will read out tomorrow as proof that you are on the right side. Back us and be part of the victory.

donation.favorTerms: The party remembers who paid for the campaign: from {min} glizars in its coffers it owes you one favor a year, one more for each further threshold, up to five at {top}. You cash a favor in before a cup match, while the party is in government.

campaign.subject: Election campaign: the coffers are open
campaign.body: You have no party, but it's election season and every campaign takes money from anyone. An outsider's contribution is booked at a tenth of its value, but it lets you show some love and maybe land a contract.

campaignDeclined.subject: {sponsor}: Donation Received
campaignDeclined.body: Your contribution is booked and the party thanks you. Unfortunately, there is no room for a new contract right now.

bodies.leader: Victory. Your party leads the government of Leskovac and you can already feel it: your sponsor's perk is stronger, the table gives you +15 points for your sponsor, and twenty glizars a season arrive from the city budget. Thank you for being part of the campaign.
bodies.partner: We are in the government as a junior partner. Nothing is taken away, nothing is added, and the biggest party knows you are their ally. Mind you, nobody can touch them, and they can touch you. The campaign paid off. Next time we aim for first place.
bodies.opposition: Not this time. Your party sits in opposition for the next two years: your sponsor's perk is weaker, the table gives you +5 points for your sponsor, and the Federation takes ten glizars a season as a solidarity contribution. The government sees you as an opponent.
bodies.none: The city voted and you were not on anyone's list. The new government owes you nothing and protects you from no one. Try to sign with somebody before the next election.

bodies.zidari: We built together, and now we hold the gate of the arena. As our donor, you are owed {favors} a year: give us a name before a match and that person does not get through the gate. The boss never forgets family.
bodies.ostrvo: Your contribution is neatly hidden, and The Island pays its debts. Every year you get {favors} on the boat for whoever you like: give us a name before a match and that person is urgently summoned to The Island to explain an account balance. Discreet as always.
bodies.korporacija: Your support has been recorded and the government is ours. As a donor you are entitled to {favors} a year, before a match of your choosing.
bodies.stranka: Freedom has won and you were part of it. The Leskovac registry is in our hands, and as a donor you are owed {favors} a year: tell us before a match who to strike off, and that person vanishes from that cup.

body.one: The Black Dwarf Corporation government is introducing a city stability contribution, mandatory for everyone not in government. The bill for this off-season comes to {amount} glizar, deducted from your account. Appeals are not permitted. Gratitude is.
body.few: The Black Dwarf Corporation government is introducing a city stability contribution, mandatory for everyone not in government. The bill for this off-season comes to {amount} glizars, deducted from your account. Appeals are not permitted. Gratitude is.
body.other: The Black Dwarf Corporation government is introducing a city stability contribution, mandatory for everyone not in government. The bill for this off-season comes to {amount} glizars, deducted from your account. Appeals are not permitted. Gratitude is.

body.one: The Black Dwarf Corporation government rewards its own: as our client you are exempt from the city stability contribution, and the difference of {amount} glizar is refunded to you. Your relatives in our apartments send their regards and thank you for your choice.
body.few: The Black Dwarf Corporation government rewards its own: as our client you are exempt from the city stability contribution, and the difference of {amount} glizars is refunded to you. Your relatives in our apartments send their regards and thank you for your choice.

pitches.zidari: Your results are as solid as our concrete, and we hear you carry the guild in your heart and put up walls even where nobody asked. People like that build with us: 70 glizars a season, and our boys guard your door day and night.
pitches.ostrvo: From The Island we follow your results and, discreetly, your bank account. We like you: 80 glizars a season, no taxes and no questions, a boat all to yourself once a year, and any little jobs you order come at a discount. Whatever we agree on stays on The Island.
pitches.korporacija: Your performance has passed our checks, congratulations. Incidentally, so have your relatives who live in our apartments: for now, they live in peace. 60 glizars a season plus 40 per cup win. We warmly recommend signing.
pitches.stranka: The results are there, and the Party also values your love of freedom, and Pčinja is the symbol of freedom. 60 glizars a season from the party coffers, and state media always has a slot for you, at double the rate.

perks.zidari: Permanent security crew: blocks 60% of sabotage.
perks.ostrvo: An island weekend once a year that doesn't use up a month. Sabotage 25% cheaper, no fine for a miss. While The Island is in government, evidence against you never reaches an indictment.
perks.stranka: Media pays double, as many times as you like.

wildcardPitches.zidari: Our people heard you telling friends how much you love the smell of fresh mortar, and that you'd put up a wall the moment you spot an empty lot. The boss wept in the middle of the building site. Love like that is not forgotten around here: the contract is ready, and one day we'll wall you in too.
wildcardPitches.ostrvo: Stories have reached The Island about your, shall we say, very creative tax returns, and about your tab at the bookie. Not to worry, nobody judges here. Here everything gets tidily hidden. People with your style are always welcome: sign, and your debts become our shared secret.
wildcardPitches.korporacija: A review of our tenant registry shows that several of your relatives live in our apartments. Think of them while you read this offer. If you sign, we will harass them by standard procedure. If you do not, we add extra shifts, and you can read about the other consequences in the paper.
wildcardPitches.stranka: The Party values a love of freedom, and you freely chose not to show up anywhere for years. That is a stance. Pčinja is freedom, and freedom is you: a spot on the poster is waiting, offer enclosed.

info.intro: A sponsor pays a fee at the end of every season and brings +10 points on the table, +10 fame on signing, and its own perk. Offers come by mail at fame 50+: in year one, a 30% chance if you reach a cup final, and from year two, 50% every off-season while you're in the table's top 5.

sponsors.zidari: 70 glizars a season. Permanent security crew: a 60% chance that sabotage against you gets stopped.
sponsors.ostrvo: 80 glizars a season. Once a year, an island weekend that doesn't use up a month: cholesterol to zero, appetite and ambition to the max. Sabotage 25% cheaper, and a botched job brings no fine and no hit to the party. While The Island sits in government, planted evidence against you never reaches an indictment.
sponsors.korporacija: 60 glizars a season plus 40 for every cup win.
sponsors.stranka: 60 glizars a season. State media: appearances pay double, and the once-a-season limit is gone.

news.poison-glizimaker: The cook who fed {name} since childhood took a bribe and spiked the batch. A night over a bucket followed.
news.poison-kafana: {name} cashed in an ALL YOU CAN EAT voucher at the Corner Tavern and ended up on a drip. The voucher was fake.
news.witch-curse: A witch walked three laps around the house of {name} and spilled something on the doorstep. The nose is gone.
news.nutrition-bribed: The nutritionist working for {name} took a bribe and rewrote the meal plan: greasy, fried, after midnight.
news.fans-rumor: Ugly rumors are going around about {name}. Bro is fuming.
news.catfish-date: SCANDAL: {name} went on a date with a fake profile set up by a rival. The whole town has seen the video.
news.catfish-zeka: {name} went to the Blue Cabin for a free round and met the forest beast. It ate the glizzies and the sneakers.
news.catfish-demons: Demons besieged the house of {name} all night. The neighbors brought salt. Nobody knows who sent them.
news.police-tax: RAID: the Pčinja tax inspector has a tip about undeclared income in the locker room of {name}. No ruling yet.
news.police-stash: INVESTIGATION: a tip claims {name} keeps a garage full of unregistered glizzies. {name} calls it winter stock.
news.police-island: LEAK: police seized a ledger from The Island. Next to a sum nobody ever declared sits the name {name}.
news.police-smuggling: SMUGGLING: inspectors suspect {name} of running cooking oil across the border. The tip came in last night.
news.sabotageBlocked: The security crew guarding {name} stood like a brick wall and stopped an incident this off-season.
news.media-interview: {name} gave the interview of the week and half the town already knows it by heart.
news.korp-vendetta: REVENGE: one week after a rejected offer, a detailed tip came in against {name}. The judge has not ruled yet.
news.korp-vendetta-failed: The plot to plant evidence on {name} fell apart overnight. Black Dwarf's only comment: the rent is still due.
news.sabotageCaught: {name} was caught attempting sabotage! The league is collecting a fine of {fine} glizars.
news.sabotageHushed: {name} was caught at sabotage, but the evidence vanished overnight. Officially it never existed. No fine.
news.sabotageCaughtHard: {name} was caught at sabotage for the SECOND time in short order! The fine: {fine} glizars.
news.scandal: BOMBSHELL: word leaked that the coach bet AGAINST their own character. {name} is beside themselves.
news.cupChampion: {name} is the cup champion! The trophy went up, the last glizzy went down, and the arena refuses to go home.
news.cupPlace-finalist: {name} loses the final and takes 2nd place in the cup. The town put the fireworks back in storage.
news.cupPlace-semis: {name} goes out in the semifinals and finishes the cup in {place} place. Two bites from the final.
news.cupPlace-quarters: {name} goes out in the quarterfinals and finishes in {place} place. No disgrace, nothing to brag about either.
news.cupPlace-early: {name} finishes the cup in {place} place after a first-round exit. The coach declines to comment.
news.cup-meltdown: {name} cracked mid-match! Cholesterol did its thing and the stretcher came out once again.
news.cup-overfull-forfeit: {name}, stuffed full of glizzies, threw up a little in the middle of a match.
news.cup-police: {name} was taken in for questioning MID-MATCH and had to forfeit. The referee says: "we can't wait".
news.cup-withdrawn: {name} has withdrawn from the tournament. Officially: fatigue. Unofficially...

tableClimb.one: {name} jumped {places} spot and now sits {place} in the table.
tableClimb.few: {name} jumped {places} spots and now sits {place} in the table.
tableClimb.other: {name} jumped {places} spots and now sits {place} in the table.

tableFall.one: {name} dropped {places} spot and is now {place} in the table. The coach blames Mercury in retrograde.
tableFall.few: {name} dropped {places} spots and is now {place} in the table. The coach blames Mercury in retrograde.
tableFall.other: {name} dropped {places} spots and is now {place} in the table. The coach blames Mercury in retrograde.

factRecord.one: Best record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} win, losses {losses}.
factRecord.few: Best record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} wins, losses {losses}.
factRecord.other: Best record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} wins, losses {losses}.

factRecordWorst.one: Worst record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} win, losses {losses}. Please don't read it out loud.
factRecordWorst.few: Worst record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} wins, losses {losses}. Please don't read it out loud.
factRecordWorst.other: Worst record in the league belongs to {name}: {wins} wins, losses {losses}. Please don't read it out loud.

news.factStreak: {name} is after the {streak} title in a row. The old Glizzy Overlords are squirming in their chairs.
news.trainUp-stomach: {name} trained the stomach and took capacity to a new level. Portions are growing, rivals are shaking.
news.trainUp-sniffer: {name} sharpened the nose to a new level. Can smell a glizzy from 20 meters.
news.trainUp-nutrition: {name} took nutrition to a new level. Now eating by the schedule, not by the smell.
news.trainUp-fans: {name} is media-trained to a new level. The cameras are in love.
news.trainDown-stomach: {name} overdid it and now has a stomach bug.
news.trainDown-sniffer: {name} overdid the nose training. Now it sneezes at fresh air.
news.trainDown-nutrition: {name} ate way too much greasy food.
news.stressWarning: {name} is on the edge of a breakdown. Cholesterol dangerously high, everyone nearby is walking on eggshells.
news.factStressHigh: {name} has the highest cholesterol in the league: {value}. The pharmacy is working double shifts.
news.factAppetiteHigh: {name} has the biggest appetite in the league: {value}. The cooks want a raise.
news.factAppetiteLow: {name} can barely look at food: appetite {value}, lowest in the league.
news.factAmbitionHigh: {name} has the highest ambition in the league: {value}. Goal: everything. Deadline: yesterday.
news.factEgoHigh: {name} has the biggest ego in the league: {value}. The arena doors are being widened.
news.factEgoLow: {name} has the smallest ego in the league: {value}. Apologizes when the referee says hello.
news.factFameHigh: {name} is the most famous in the league: fame {value}. Can't go to the store without sunglasses.
news.factFameLow: {name} is the least noticed in the league: fame {value}. Even the home locker room asks for ID.
news.factAmbitionLow: {name} has the lowest ambition in the league: {value}. Season goal: don't finish last.
news.factStomachBest: {name} has the best-trained stomach in the league: level {value}. The cooks are scared.
news.factSnifferBest: {name} has the best nose in the league: level {value}. Can smell a glizzy through a wall.
news.factNutritionBest: {name} has the most disciplined diet in the league: level {value}.
news.factFansBest: {name} is the most media-trained in the league: level {value}. The cameras follow all the way to the tavern.
news.comeback: {name} is back after a long break, with a coach who has zero references. Return to form, or new charity case?
news.comeback-mp: {name} is back after a long break, coached by {coach}, zero references. Return to form, or new charity case?
news.commentator-back: The broadcast is back! The Federation found money for a microphone, and an old voice returns behind it.
news.betting-banned: The Federation reminds everyone: betting is still banned since certain people got caught fixing matches.
news.betting-unlocked: Official: the betting ban is lifted and the bookmaker is back this cup. Odds follow the table, so look first.
news.rival-announced: {player} had barely unpacked when {name} sent word through a friend: see you at the cup, bring a bucket.
news.rival-chosen: Asked about the new year, {player} said one name: {name}, then glared at the camera like it was its fault.
news.rival-derby-win: {name} won the derby of the year! {rival} left through the side exit and half the town is buying rounds.
news.rival-derby-loss: {name} lost the derby! {rival} ate the glizzy and the dignity along with it, and the whole town was watching.
news.invest-security: {name} hired a security crew for good. People in black guard the locker room. Both eyes shut at night, at last.
news.invest-security-up: The security crew around {name} grows to level {level}. One of them nobody knows, but everybody obeys.
news.invest-spa: {name} bought a yearly spa pass. Steam and a massage every morning, and {name} comes back red and far calmer.
news.invest-spa-up: Spa package for {name} goes to level {level}. Now with mud from a faraway sea. The cholesterol is melting.
news.invest-assistant: {name} hired an assistant coach, who runs training alone while the head coach is off gambling.
news.invest-assistant-up: The staff around {name} grows to level {level}. Nobody knows who is training who, but the numbers go up.
news.invest-scout: {name} found a guy who sits in the right taverns, listens to league people and reports back.
news.invest-scout-up: The informant network of {name} grows to level {level}. People in the gyms and behind every bar.
news.election-year: Election year. Four parties are going to the voters: {parties}. Votes get counted after the Bloody Cup.
news.election-poll: The early poll before the last cup ahead of the election. Projected seats in the Leskovac Assembly.
news.election-result: The votes are counted. The government of Leskovac: {parties}, with {seats} of 100 seats.
news.election-result-alone: The votes are counted. {parties} rules Leskovac alone with {seats} of 100 seats. No partners needed, they say.
news.glizi-price-up: Glizzflation won't quit: a glizzy costs {pct}% more than last off-season. Nothing in town ever gets cheaper.
news.glizi-price-down: Glizzflation dips: Pčinja sent two truckloads by mistake and a glizzy costs {pct}% less than last off-season.
news.cup-removed: Never even sat down: {name} was led away before the match, no explanation given.
news.removal-zidari: Gate Security held {name} at the arena entrance. The match goes down as a forfeit.
news.removal-ostrvo: {name} vanished five minutes before the match. Last seen on a boat to The Island, possibly not by choice.
news.removal-korporacija: Bailiffs at the door: {name} was removed from the chair over unpaid rent.
news.removal-stranka: According to the new census, {name} does not exist and never has, anywhere in Leskovac. Neither has the match.

sabotage.fundHint: This is the chance the job goes through at all, without the league catching it and calling it off. Pay extra to raise it. After that it still has to get past the target's security crew, if the target has one.

1.name: Diversion
1.desc: One of the target's trainings takes a hit, a whole level or just two sessions. Which one? Surprise.

2.name: Nightmare
2.desc: Right before the cup, the target lives through a night they will never forget.

3.name: Plant evidence
3.desc: A tip starts an investigation into the target and lands in the paper. If the judge confirms the warrant, police take the target away IN THE MIDDLE of a match. The better you pay, the surer the judge: a fully paid job means a guaranteed arrest.

summary.hint: Total chance: the job first has to get past the league, then past the target's security crew too. A +? means the target may have guards you can't see.

hub.title: Glizzy Manager and Rivals
hub.intro: Two games, one league. Coach your character through the seasons solo, or open a room and out-eat your friends at the table.
hub.about: Glizzy Manager started as a private game built for a group of friends. This is the sanitized public edition: every inside joke, real person and private reference has been removed, the characters are fictional, and the game is available in English and Serbian. It exists to show how the game works and how it was built.

about.title: Welcome to the table
about.body: Glizzy Manager began as a private game for a group of friends; this public edition keeps the whole game with fictional characters. You coach one eater through a hot-dog eating league: cups and seasons, sponsors who double as political parties, a newspaper that misses nothing, some sabotage, and a long climb to Glizzy Overlord.

language.title: Pick a language
language.body: It applies right away. Nothing else changes.

look.title: Look and sound
look.body: Dark or light, loud or quiet. Everything here can be changed later from the gear in the corner.

modes.title: Two ways to play
modes.manager: A solo career. The save lives in this browser.
modes.rivals: Rooms with a code, up to eight coaches at one table.

intro-rivalry-1.text: This is not just a match, folks. {a} and {b} have unfinished business.
intro-rivalry-1.tts: This is not just a match, folks. These two have unfinished business.

intro-rivalry-2.text: {a} versus {b}. History says when these two meet, something has to snap.
intro-rivalry-2.tts: History says when these two meet, something has to snap.

intro-leader-1.text: {name}, top of the table right now. Playing like the glizzies run away on their own.

intro-leader-2.text: Top of the table, {name}. When this one sits down, the bookies close up shop.

intro-leader-3.text: {name} defends the top spot tonight. And the top, folks, is the longest way down.

intro-lossstreak-1.text: {name} is on a losing streak. Something has to give. Tonight or next week, that's the only question.

intro-lossstreak-2.text: On the other side, {name}. Form? None. Spite? Spite to spare.

intro-lossstreak-3.text: {name} loses, and loses, and loses. But tonight, they say, tonight is different.

intro-title-1.text: {name}, the defending champion. They say champions smell fear. This one smells everything.

intro-title-2.text: Here comes {name}. The title protects, but the title also weighs a ton.

intro-title-3.text: {name} is chasing history. One more title and nobody gets to say a word.

intro-meltdown-1.text: {name}, for whom the physio keeps a standing appointment. Let's see if tonight holds together.

intro-meltdown-2.text: Keep an eye on {name}. On a good night, goes all the way. On a bad one, cracks in front of everybody.

intro-meltdown-3.text: {name} and pressure, an old romance. The only question is who breaks whom tonight.

intro-hat-1.text: {name} loves the hat. Everybody knows it. {name} knows everybody knows it. Still goes for the hat.

intro-hat-2.text: They say {name} reaches for the hat even while asleep. Tonight we find out.

intro-sock-1.text: {name} and the sock. Now that is a love for life.

intro-sock-2.text: The sock calls, {name} picks up. Every time.

intro-box-1.text: For {name}, the box is not a hiding spot. The box is home.

intro-box-2.text: {name} goes for the box even when it's wrong. Especially when it's wrong.

intro-epithet-1.text: {name}, {epithet}. What more is there to say.

intro-epithet-2.text: And here we are. {name}, {epithet}, in the flesh.

intro-epithet-3.text: {name}. {epithet}. The crowd knows, the crowd remembers.

open-1.text: Good evening, folks. Sixteen contestants, one title, and far too many glizzies for one night. Here we go.

open-2.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome. The table is set, the form is in, so let's see whose legs give out tonight, and whose nose.

open-3.text: Good evening, dear viewers. Some came for the trophy, some out of spite, and some, I suspect, are just hungry.

open-4.text: Good evening, folks. The table is laid, the glizzies are warm, the nerves are thin. Let's begin.

next-2.text: No rest, folks. The glizzies keep rolling.

next-3.text: The next pair steps up to the table.

next-4.text: Straight on to the next one. The schedule shows no mercy.

start-1.text: The glizzy is on the table. Off we go!

start-2.text: The referee watches, the crowd goes quiet. We're underway.

start-3.text: Three lives, one glizzy. Let's go.

start-4.text: Hands on the table, eyes on the glizzy. Off we go.

dodge-4.text: Good read, or dumb luck. Either way, still alive.

dodge-6.text: Wrong one! The glizzy stays put!
dodge-6.tts: Wrong one! The glizzy stays put!

dodge-7.text: A miss. We live another round.

dodgestreak-1.text: Another miss! Two in a row!
dodgestreak-1.tts: Another miss! Two in a row!

dodgestreak-2.text: This isn't a match, this is ballet!
dodgestreak-2.tts: This isn't a match, this is ballet!

dodgestreak-3.text: Nobody can find a thing! That glizzy is a ghost, folks!
dodgestreak-3.tts: Nobody can find a thing! That glizzy is a ghost, folks!

dodgestreak-4.text: Miss after miss! What do these people live on, luck?!
dodgestreak-4.tts: Miss after miss! What do these people live on, luck?!

dodgestreak-5.text: How long can this go on?! Nobody wants to eat!
dodgestreak-5.tts: How long can this go on?! Nobody wants to eat!

grab-1.text: There it is! Found it! And now it has to go down...
grab-1.tts: There it is! Found it! And now it has to go down...

grab-2.text: It's there! Ow, ow, ow... enjoy your meal, chief.
grab-2.tts: It's there! Ow, ow, ow... enjoy your meal, chief.

grab-3.text: Found it! And around here, finders eaters!
grab-3.tts: Found it! And around here, finders eaters!

grab-4.text: Direct hit! Which is the bad news!
grab-4.tts: Direct hit! Which is the bad news!

grab-5.text: Oh no! Actually found it! Down it goes, folks, swallowing fate itself!
grab-5.tts: Oh no! Actually found it! Down it goes, folks, swallowing fate itself!

grab-6.text: There it is! And you know what comes next. Dig in!
grab-6.tts: There it is! And you know what comes next. Dig in!

binge-1.text: That was on purpose! Hunger is a wonder, folks!
binge-1.tts: That was on purpose! Hunger is a wonder, folks!

binge-2.text: That's not tactics, that's appetite! Straight for the glizzy!
binge-2.tts: That's not tactics, that's appetite! Straight for the glizzy!

binge-3.text: The rules are forgotten. Only lunch is remembered!
binge-3.tts: The rules are forgotten. Only lunch is remembered!

random-1.text: This... this is random. The hand moves on its own, the head left long ago.

random-2.text: Stress is doing its work. Picking with eyes shut, folks.

random-3.text: Nobody is deciding anything anymore. The nerves are picking now.

random-4.text: Hand goes left, eyes go right, brain is on vacation. Pure gambling.

sniff-1.text: The nose! Saved by the nose!
sniff-1.tts: The nose! Saved by the nose!

sniff-2.text: The hand was going, but the nose says no! What instinct!
sniff-2.tts: The hand was going, but the nose says no! What instinct!

sniff-3.text: Sniffed it out! At the last second!
sniff-3.tts: Sniffed it out! At the last second!

sniff-4.text: That's what you call a nose, ladies and gentlemen! They don't teach that in school!
sniff-4.tts: That's what you call a nose, ladies and gentlemen! They don't teach that in school!

sniff-5.text: Full stop! The nose pulled that hand right back! Unbelievable!
sniff-5.tts: Full stop! The nose pulled that hand right back! Unbelievable!

sniff-6.text: That nose is working overtime! What a save!
sniff-6.tts: That nose is working overtime! What a save!

meltdown-1.text: Snapped! Snapped in front of everybody, folks!
meltdown-1.tts: Snapped! Snapped in front of everybody, folks!

meltdown-2.text: No, no, no... and that's it. The nerves said enough.

meltdown-3.text: Hold on, hold on... it's over! The head couldn't take it!
meltdown-3.tts: Hold on, hold on... it's over! The head couldn't take it!

meltdown-4.text: Explosion! Everything bottled up came out at once!
meltdown-4.tts: Explosion! Everything bottled up came out at once!

police-1.text: Police! Police at the table, the match is stopped!
police-1.tts: Police! Police at the table, the match is stopped!

police-2.text: Flashing lights, folks! Nobody planned for this!
police-2.tts: Flashing lights, folks! Nobody planned for this!

police-3.text: Everybody scatter! Match over, the law is carrying off the glizzy!
police-3.tts: Everybody scatter! Match over, the law is carrying off the glizzy!

police-4.text: Sirens, folks! This sport and the law were never friends!
police-4.tts: Sirens, folks! This sport and the law were never friends!

overfull-1.text: Can't go on! Full to the brim, folks, the match is forfeited!
overfull-1.tts: Can't go on! Full to the brim, folks, the match is forfeited!

overfull-2.text: The stomach has spoken. End of the road.

overfull-3.text: Too many glizzies, too little room. It's over.

overfull-4.text: Capacity is capacity. Beaten by physics, not by the opponent.

withdrawn-1.text: No match, folks. Forfeited without a fight. The head just wasn't there.

withdrawn-2.text: Withdrew before the start. Ugly, but understandable.

withdrawn-3.text: Signed up, announced, and never showed. A sad sight, folks.

tiebreak-1.text: Extra time, folks. First to find the glizzy loses. Yes, you heard that right.

tiebreak-2.text: All or nothing. Two glizzies on the table, and only one decides it.

tiebreak-3.text: This is sudden death. Even the crowd has stopped breathing.

tiebreak-4.text: Sweaty palms, two glizzies waiting. One move between glory and shame.

quick-1.text: It's over! In three minutes! You can't finish a coffee that fast!
quick-1.tts: It's over! In three minutes! You can't finish a coffee that fast!

quick-2.text: Express service, folks! Blink and you missed the match!
quick-2.tts: Express service, folks! Blink and you missed the match!

quick-4.text: Lightning! The scorekeeper never even found a pencil!
quick-4.tts: Lightning! The scorekeeper never even found a pencil!

long-1.text: This one is dragging, folks. But great things are never over quickly.

long-2.text: A marathon! The crowd has sat down, the glizzy is still out there.

long-3.text: On we go, nobody gives an inch. This is a war of attrition.

long-4.text: Hour three, folks. Somebody check if that glizzy is still fresh.

winner-3.text: The winner is {name}. Deserved, I have to say.

winner-4.text: {name} celebrates! People will remember this one for a long time!
winner-4.tts: {name} celebrates! People will remember this one for a long time!

comedown-1.text: And there you have it, folks. The table doesn't lie.

comedown-2.text: Experience made the difference. Moving on.

comedown-3.text: That's that. One celebrates, one skips dinner tonight. Although, frankly, dinner already happened.

comedown-4.text: Write this result down. I have a feeling we'll be bringing it up.

comedown-5.text: It's in the books. And we move on, the glizzies won't hide themselves.

weather-ledeno-1.text: A blizzard outside, and the glizzies are steaming double. A perfect night for this sport.

weather-ledeno-2.text: It's seriously below zero, folks. Drop a glizzy tonight and you'll find it in spring.

weather-ledeno-3.text: The thermometer has dropped below anything decent, folks. But who said this was a decent sport.

weather-ledeno-4.text: Snow is falling, the table is frozen, and the mustard cuts with a knife. A proper winter night for this sport.

weather-krvavo-1.text: It's autumn, the leaves are falling, and with them, I suspect, a favorite or two.

weather-krvavo-2.text: The sky is red tonight, folks. The old-timers say that means something. We say: ideal conditions.

weather-krvavo-3.text: Fog has settled on the valley, folks. You can see as far as the glizzy, and that's all we need.

weather-krvavo-4.text: Wind in the leaves, rain on the way, and the contestants came without umbrellas. With glizzies, of course.

weather-letnje-1.text: A tropical night, folks. The glizzies are sweating, the contestants even more.

weather-letnje-2.text: It's summer, the table is warm, and the appetites, the appetites are maxed out.

weather-letnje-3.text: Muggy since morning, folks. The mustard is melting, and so are we.

weather-letnje-4.text: Not a breath of wind tonight. The mosquitoes have already counted the contestants. We'll count them after.

weather-patlidzan-1.text: It's spring, everything is in bloom, and the eggplants, folks, the eggplants are glorious.

weather-patlidzan-2.text: You can smell the spring, you can smell the grass, but strongest of all, as always, you can smell the glizzy.

weather-patlidzan-3.text: Pollen in the air, folks, and tears in the eyes. Some from allergies, some from the draw.

weather-patlidzan-4.text: The first real sun of the year warms the table. The eggplants are shining. We'll see who else does.

election-stranka-1.text: A new government, folks: the People's List. Freedom has won, they say, so step one is freeing the voter roll of everyone who voted wrong.

election-stranka-2.text: The Assembly belongs to the People's List. State media already report that everything is excellent, and we, to be safe, will say the same.

election-stranka-3.text: The People's List runs Leskovac. All of Leskovac is one step closer to freedom, they say. And freedom, of course, means state media has one channel as of tomorrow.

election-zidari-1.text: The Masons' Guild has formed the government. First measure: a wall around the Assembly and new houses for all the loyalists.

election-zidari-2.text: The Masons are the new boss in town, folks. Overnight, a security crew costs more for anyone who voted wrong.

election-zidari-3.text: The Masons run Leskovac. The boss says the town will be walled in on all sides by winter.

election-korporacija-1.text: The Black Dwarf Corporation leads the government. First change to the law: a town stability contribution, and a new fee for anyone who doesn't vote Black Dwarf.

election-korporacija-2.text: The Corporation is in power, folks. Black Dwarf promises Leskovac will be the most stable town in the region, once the freeloaders are evicted.

election-korporacija-3.text: Black Dwarf runs Leskovac. The bailiffs got new uniforms, and the town got new fees.

election-ostrvo-1.text: The Island has taken the government, folks. As of this morning the town budget sits in an account nobody is allowed to mention.

election-ostrvo-2.text: The new government arrives by dinghy. The Island runs Leskovac, which, we're now told, was always a seaside town.

election-ostrvo-3.text: The Island is in power. Taxes are abolished, and discretion is the town's new policy.
